title: Impact, train not operational, hazmat wagon damaged, residential buildings 300 m away
_comment: The showcase case: tier 3 with two keys and quarantine. All wagons belong to one customer -- another customer would be one more entry in 'federations' and one more contract file, with no code change. For the demo it stays at one.

carrier_overrides._why: Train not operational, hazmat damaged, main line closed. An incident of this size is market sensitive, so from the moment this flag is read every outbound channel is shut.

truth._status: PROPOSAL from the engine track -- please confirm or correct
truth.why: Hazmat wagon W05 damaged around the cargo compartment, train not operational, residential buildings 300 m away, no alternative route, no road access. Not knowing about a hazmat leak next to homes is itself the reason to stop and report.

also_true._comment: The situation differs per wagon, but the train decision dominates: tier 3 is the highest tier involved, and it applies to the whole train. This block is documentation for the view, not a separate decision and not a separate grant.

W02.why: Pharma precursor outside its window for 55 minutes, train stopped

truth._teaches: Tier 3 needs two DIFFERENT humans. market_sensitive is true, so the quarantine shuts every outbound channel -- visible in the banner. And the contract penalty is BELOW the threshold: the assessor picks the strictest measure even though it is the cheapest penalty.
